sites.executive_summary: The highest stored owner claim is 0.2600 for the D2.8/Poisson 300 m off-catalogue raster. The current MSDB1 owner claim supplied by the task is 0.1462. Its separate catalogue-proxy HOLDOUT-DTI result is 0.170462 with evaluator component-holdout-v3-blockstats-20261025, 60,988 withheld positives, and 95% CI [0.156227, 0.184168]; it is not comparable to, or a replacement for, the owner/organizer claim.

The highest ledger claim is 0.2708 for H27-4 solo d=2.8. Its in-footprint raster is byte-identical to the GEMSDOE28 H27-4 solo d=2.8 raster in the frozen audit, so these are not independent methods or evidence. No newer site claim was supplied in this task.

The top ledger claim across the nine sites is 0.2778 for H33/B2. Byte-level reconstruction shows its 37,654-dot support equals the GEMSDOE28 d=2.8 support after deleting the 2,545 dots within 2 pixels of catalogue labels. That establishes a pruning/spacing lineage, not a new geological discovery, and does not authenticate that the claimed score was returned for these exact bytes.

The highest ledger claim is 0.2632 for H33D analog tip-stepover R30. Its raster is a close support duplicate of H33: 99.984% of H33 dots lie within 3 pixels of H33D. A distinct method or score is not established by the filename or owner-reported value.

The highest ledger claim is 0.2750 for an Anderson-geothermal PINN raster. All H33 dots lie within 3 pixels of the GEMSDOE36 reference in the frozen novelty audit, so the support is not independent of H33. No newer site claim was supplied in this task.
